title: US Natural Gas Plant Construction Plans Surge 44% in Eight Months
detail: US natural gas plant construction plans surged 44% in just eight months, signaling a counter-trend to the clean energy transition as utilities and data centers drive fossil fuel demand. The surge reflects growing electricity demand that renewables alone are not meeting fast enough, with AI data centers and industrial loads pushing grid operators back toward dispatchable gas generation.
